evidence: During ALD, the absence of hydroxyl sites on the unexposed regions of the polymer film prevents TiO2 from nucleating in these areas. Active OH sites generated in exposed regions lead to nucleation and growth of a thin, conformal titania film on the polymer surface as demonstrated in the X-ray photoelectron spectra (XPS) presented in Fig. 3. The scanning electron microscopy (SEM) image presented in Fig. 4 also shows that a conformal layer of TiO2 is deposited onto the exposed regions of the PtBMA polymer film.
